PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Reports Steady Trade Volumes Amid Stable Regional Demand

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, a prominent player in the Oil & Gas Services & Equip sector in the United Arab Emirates, reported stable trade figures for the most recent quarter, reflecting steady regional demand and continued project activity across the Gulf.

According to a statement by the company’s spokesperson, quarterly trade volumes remained in line with expectations. “Our operations have maintained a consistent pace, supported by ongoing contracts and routine maintenance work for key clients in the region,” said Nguyen Van Hoang, Head of Trade Relations at PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp. “We continue to see healthy demand for technical and logistical support from our core customer base.”

Total trade volumes for the quarter reached 2.3 million metric tons, a figure comparable to the same period last year. Analysts note that these results underscore the sector’s resilience, even as global energy markets show signs of volatility. “The stability in volumes reflects the reliability of ongoing infrastructure projects and the importance of technical services in the UAE’s oil and gas value chain,” commented Aisha Al-Farsi, an energy analyst at Rasheed Capital Partners.

Sector insiders attribute the steady performance to continued investment in oilfield development and equipment upgrades by local producers. “We expect trade volumes in the oil and gas services segment to remain robust, supported by the government’s commitment to energy diversification and infrastructure modernization,” said Khaled Mansour, spokesperson for the UAE Oil & Gas Services Trade Association.

No significant disruptions or changes in regulatory conditions were reported during the period. The outlook for the coming quarter remains stable, with PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp emphasizing its commitment to operational reliability and customer service. The company’s next update is expected with its mid-year financial results in August.
